scene: Cover art for Annihilation #1 of 6, featuring an ensemble of cosmic characters posed dramatically against a blue-lit cosmic backdrop with Annihilus looming at the center foreground.

A full-page narration spread across three time-stamped vignettes—Annihilation Day, Day Plus 7, and Day Plus 15-79—depicting the Annihilation Wave's invasion of the universe, the destruction of Xandar, and the obliteration of the Skrull Empire, narrated via Nova Corps verbal log.

dialogue.text: VERBAL LOG. NOVA CORPS OPERATIVE: 11249-44396/RICHARD RIDER-- LAST SURVIVOR OF THE NOVA CORPS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THE MASSIVE INVADING ENEMY PUNCHED THROUGH THE "CRUNCH."
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THE CRUNCH IS THE BOUNDARY OF OUR UNIVERSE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THAT MEANS THEY CAME FROM BEYOND OUR UNIVERSE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THAT'S HOW NOVA CORPS GOT INVOLVED.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: XANDAR, THE CORPS' HOMEWORLD, WAS DEVASTATED BY THEIR ATTACK--WE WERE WIPED OUT.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THEY CALL THEMSELVES THE ANNIHILATION WAVE. THEY LIVE UP TO THE NAME. IT TOOK THEM LESS THAN SIX MONTHS TO ERADICATE WHAT WAS LEFT OF THE SKRULL EMPIRE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: TRUTH TO TELL, THERE'S MORE THAN A DOZEN SKRULL WORLDS THAT WE CAN'T EVEN LOCATE!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ANNIHILATION WAVE... ANNIHILUS. NOT EVERYONE MADE THE CONNECTION. GO FIGURE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: FROM WHAT WE'VE BEEN ABLE TO PIECE TOGETHER, OUR UNIVERSE IS EXPANDING INTO THE UNIVERSE ANNIHILUS RULES--CALLED THE NEGATIVE ZONE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ANNIHILUS IS TAKING BACK WHAT HE CONSIDERS HIS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A massive battle scene on Daedalus 5 at the Kree-System periphery, where Nova commands the United Front against the Annihilation Wave amid widespread chaos and explosions.

dialogue.text: WE'RE HOLDING OFF THE WAVE NOT AS IMPRESSIVE AS WE'RE BEATING THEM BUT I'LL TAKE WHAT I CAN GET.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: I'M NOT BEING FAIR. AFTER SIX MONTHS OF BARELY SLOWING THEM DOWN, HOLDING THEM BACK COUNTS FOR A LOT.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: THE WAVE IS PUSHING IN HARD. BUT WE'RE FINALLY GETTING ORGANIZED ENOUGH TO FIGHT.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: IF WE DON'T HOLD THEM HERE, IT'S OVER.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: YOU ABOUT READY TO START PAYING ATTENTION NOW, RICHIE?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: AND BY 'WE' I'M TALKING ANYONE OR ANY THING STILL ABLE TO HOLD A WEAPON.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: A man in a blue tactical suit stands on a raised platform briefing someone about a team member called Star-Lord, while soldiers and defenders hold a perimeter in the background.

dialogue.text: WITH THE SKRULLS GONE, YOU BETTER HAVE AN ACE UP YOUR--
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: MR. SUNSHINE'S MY NUMBER TWO, GOES BY THE NAME PETER QUILL, USED TO BE CALLED STARLORD. QUILL SIGNED ON RIGHT AFTER THE TARTUS MINOR DEBACLE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: LIE TO ME.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: OKAY, TRY THIS--THE FORCE FIELDS WILL HOLD. THAT WHAT YOU WANTED TO HEAR?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Nova (without helmet) and another soldier discuss Gamora's black ops missions while a female figure (likely Gamora) stands armed in a war-torn environment with troops falling back.

dialogue.text: TAKES A GOOD BIT OF COURAGE TO SIGN ON AFTER WITNESSING ONE OF HISTORY'S BLOODIEST DEFEATS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ALL NONESSENTIAL PERSONNEL ARE FALLING BACK TO THE SECONDARY PERIMETER.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: THIS IS A MASSACRE IN THE MAKING. IF WE'RE GONNA MAKE A LAST STAND, I'D RATHER IT BE ON OUR TERMS.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: DOES GAMORA AGREE?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: GAMORA'S GOT HER HANDS FULL RUNNING BLACK OPS. SHE'S BETTER'N A DOZEN HIT-AND-RUN TEAMS OUT THERE TARGETING COMMAND CENTERS.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: SUICIDE RUNNERS? MAKES SENSE. SHE'S HARD CORE.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: THEN AGAIN, HE COULD BE CRAZY. LORD KNOWS, CRAZY'S EASY TO COME BY OUT HERE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Nova (without helmet) jokes with another figure about Gamora's battle strategy while reviewing a display screen, as a narrator caption comments on his sanity.

dialogue.text: GAMORA'S STILL SINGING THE SAME OLD SONG. "BRING THE FIGHT TO THEM" IN C MINOR.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: C MINOR?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: I JUST THREW THAT IN.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: THROW IT OUT AGAIN.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: LIKE I SAID. HE JUST MIGHT BE CRAZY.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Nova narrates about Peter Quill's past as the Starlord while a chaotic battle unfolds in the background, with a bearded man reacting to a loud crash.

dialogue.text: DID I MENTION HE USED TO BE THE STARLORD? GUY WAS A LIVING LEGEND. SOMETHING...HAPPENED. HE WON'T TALK ABOUT IT, BUT IT HAD TO BE BRUTAL.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: ASK HIM ABOUT IT AND HE'LL TELL YOU "THE STARLORD IS DEAD." PERIOD. NO MORE, NO LESS.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: THAT CAN'T BE GOOD.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Nova (without helmet) demands a situation report from someone named Peter amid a chaotic battle, as soldiers scramble around him and a large armored figure looms on the right.

dialogue.text: TALK TO ME, PETER!
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: RIGHT FLANK O76'S FORCE-BARRICADES JUST BLEW! IT'S GONNA CASCADE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: IN ENGLISH!?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: A group of soldiers take cover on a rooftop as massive pink energy force fields explode in the sky behind them.

dialogue.text: THE FORCE FIELDS ARE GONNA BLOW!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Nova stands in the middle of a chaotic battlefield, checking a tactical display while insectoid Annihilation Wave enemies swarm the right flank amid explosive pink energy bursts.

dialogue.text: WHO'S ON RIGHT FLANK?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: DOES IT MATTER!?
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: The 2nd and 3rd Kree Battalions on the right flank at position 076 are overwhelmed as Annihilation Wave forces breach their defensive line, with soldiers shouting orders amid explosions and chaos.

dialogue.text: HELL YEAH. IT ALWAYS MATTERS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: WE'RE BREACHED!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: LINE OF FIRE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: STAND YOUR GROUND!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: CONTROLLED BURSTS! MAKE THEM COUNT!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Warriors are overwhelmed by a swarm of alien creatures in a chaotic battle, with multiple fighters calling out warnings and struggling to hold their ground.

dialogue.text: KREE COMMAND PROTOCOLS, AS WE'VE COME TO UNDERSTAND THEM, HAVE BROKEN DOWN. IT'S LIKE THEY'VE FORGOTTEN HOW TO WAGE WAR, AND THE KREE LIVE FOR WAR.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ...TOO MANY!
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

dialogue.text: STAND YOUR GROUND!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: THEY'RE EVERYWHERE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: ARGH!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: HOLD POSITIONS!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Ronan the Accuser fires a powerful energy blast on the battlefield while commanding Kree soldiers to fall back and form a secondary perimeter, as narrator captions describe the staggering Kree casualties under the House of Fiyero's control of Hala.

dialogue.text: SINCE THE HOUSE OF FIYERO SEIZED CONTROL OF HALA, THEY JUST THROW WARM BODIES AT THE WAVE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: KREE CASUALTIES HAVE BEEN... STAGGERING.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: FALL BACK! FORM A SECONDARY PERIMETER! ALTERNATE COVERING FIRE! MOVE YOUR BEDRAGGLED SHANKS!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: WE LUCKED OUT THIS TIME. RONAN WAS ON-SITE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A soldier urgently pleads with a hooded commander (Ronan the Accuser) to retreat as their front collapses in flames behind them.

dialogue.text: HE USED TO GO BY RONAN THE ACCUSER--JUDGE, JURY AND EXECUTIONER. ONE-STOP SHOPPING FOR ALL YOUR LAW ENFORCEMENT NEEDS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: WOULD YOU SEE THEM DEAD, COMMANDER?! FALL BACK! THIS FRONT IS LOST!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A masked figure (Ronan the Accused) faces a shouting armored enemy soldier who challenges his authority, declaring allegiance to House Fiyero, while a narrator caption contextualizes Ronan's fugitive status.

dialogue.text: THAT WAS THEN. NOW HE'S A FUGITIVE FROM THE SAME KREE JUSTICE HE USED TO ENFORCE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: RONAN THE ACCUSED! YOU CARRY NO AUTHORITY HERE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: OUR ALLEGIANCE IS TO HOUSE FIYERO--
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: COMMANDER...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A hooded figure stabs or strikes a green-skinned enemy, relieving them of duty, while a narrator caption reflects on Ronan's honesty regarding mass murder charges.

dialogue.text: HE WAS CHARGED WITH MASS MURDER. HE SAYS THEY WERE TRUMPED UP. THAT'S WHAT THEY ALL SAY...BUT RONAN, HIM I BELIEVE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: I DON'T THINK HE'S CAPABLE OF LYING.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ...YOU'RE RELIEVED OF DUTY.
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

scene: A close-up of an alien Kree soldier's face as a narrator caption observes that rank-and-file Kree don't believe the charges and that someone commands their attention.

dialogue.text: YOU CAN TELL THE RANK-AND-FILE KREE DON'T BUY THE CHARGES EITHER.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: HE TALKS, THEY LISTEN.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A Kree soldier shouts orders to fall back amid a fiery, chaotic battlefield.

dialogue.text: FALL BACK! ENGAGE AND WITH-DRAW! REMEMBER YOU ARE KREE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Soldiers fire heavy weapons during a chaotic retreat while a commander (likely Ronan) directs forces amid failing force field generators, as a narrator recounts how he turned a bloodbath into an orderly withdrawal.

dialogue.text: I DON'T KNOW HOW HE ASSUMED COMMAND AND I DON'T CARE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ALL I KNOW IS HE TOOK WHAT COULD HAVE BEEN A BLOODBATH AND TURNED IT INTO AN ORDERLY WITHDRAWAL. HE BOUGHT US SOME DESPERATELY NEEDED TIME.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THE KREE POSITIONS WERE HIT HARDEST BUT BECAUSE OF RONAN, THEY SUFFERED THE FEWEST FATALITIES.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: YEAH...RONAN'S A KEEPER.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: FORCE FIELD GENERATORS ARE GIVING OUT! MOVE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A team of heroes retreats from a collapsing defensive position as alien creatures swarm and explosions erupt around them, with someone ordering a full withdrawal to the secondary perimeter.

dialogue.text: ALL DUE RESPECT, SIR, BUT WE ARE OUT OF HERE!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: THAT WAS THE FIRST FORCE-FIELD GENERATOR. THE REST ARE GONNA DOMINO.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: WITHDRAW. PULL BACK TO SECONDARY PERIMETER. TELL EVERYONE, PETER!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A group of heroes retreats from a massive explosion and wave of enemies at night, with a pink-haired woman in the foreground and a narrator caption commenting on being forced back repeatedly.

dialogue.text: THIS IS THE THIRD TIME WE'VE BEEN FORCED BACK AND IF YOU THINK IT'S FRUSTRATING FOR US, IMAGINE WHAT IT'S LIKE FOR THE WAVE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: HOW MUCH TIME DO WE HAVE BEFORE--
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: NEVER MIND.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A large insectoid creature attacks ships with energy blasts during an ongoing battle, as silhouetted figures watch from the foreground and someone shouts a warning to get clear.

dialogue.text: THEY'RE STILL FIGHTING THE SAME WAR THEY WERE FIGHTING SIX MONTHS AGO. WE'RE NOT.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: EVERY CASUALTY WE'VE TAKEN HAS TAUGHT US THAT MUCH MORE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THEY'RE HITTING THE SHIPS! GET CLEAR!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A chaotic battlefield at Tartus Minor is shown from above, with alien creatures and soldiers being bombarded by an orbital beam strike from enemy ships in space.

dialogue.text: WE GOT OUR BUTTS KICKED AT TARTUS MINOR BECAUSE WE WERE STILL WAGING A TWO-DIMENSIONAL WAR. THEY NAILED US FROM ORBIT.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: NO WAY...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A multi-panel action sequence at Daedalus 5's orbit perimeter showing former Heralds of Galactus—Firelord, Red Shift, and Stardust—battling the Annihilation Wave's forces in space while narrator captions explain their role in defending the airspace.

dialogue.text: ...DO WE LET THAT HAPPEN AGAIN.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: WE'VE GOT THE FIRELORD, RED SHIFT AND STARDUST TO SEE TO THAT. EACH ONE A FORMER HERALD OF GALACTUS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: INDIVIDUALLY, EACH PACKS ENOUGH FIREPOWER TO HOLD OFF AN ARMY.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: RUMOR IS IT THAT ANNIHILUS HAS PRIORITIZED THEIR CAPTURE, THAT OTHER EX-HERALDS HAVE ALREADY BEEN TAKEN.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: I'VE SEEN THE FIREPOWER THE WAVE THROWS AT THEM. MAKES ME THINK "APPREHEND" MAY HAVE BEEN UPGRADED TO "TERMINATE"-- JUST LIKE THE REST OF US.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THE EX-HERALDS HAD BEEN WAGING THEIR OWN PRIVATE WAR, HITTING THE WAVE WHEN THEY COULD AND MAKING THEMSELVES SCARCE WHEN THINGS GOT OUT OF HAND.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THEY FOUND US BY FOLLOWING THE SHOOTING, HOOKED UP WITH US BECAUSE OF SOMETHING PETER SAID TO THE FIRELORD.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THEY CAN'T COVER THE ENTIRE PLANET BUT THEY CAN KEEP OUR AIRSPACE CLEAR.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: At the Command Center, Nova (without helmet) charges into battle rather than retreating, exchanging words with allies about leading from the front amid explosions and enemy fire.

dialogue.text: RICHIE, KEEP RUNNING! WHY ARE YOU--
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: I CAN'T LEAD FROM THE REAR.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: RICHIE, YOU--
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: HOW MANY TIMES HAVE I TOLD YOU NOT TO CALL ME RICHIE?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: HUH... LOST COUNT.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A pale green-skinned woman with pink hair delivers a cold remark, with a shadowy figure visible behind her.

dialogue.text: THREE TOO MANY.
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

scene: Nova, helmet on, tersely responds to someone off-panel while Nova_nohelmet looks on grimly in the background.

dialogue.text: MAKE IT FOUR.
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: Nova without his helmet runs urgently through an explosive battlefield, shouting orders to get their allies clear.

dialogue.text: DAS'T ALL!
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: GET OUR BOYS CLEAR, PETER...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Nova charges through a battlefield firing energy blasts at insectoid enemies while quipping to a large red figure on the right.

dialogue.text: IT'S ABOUT TO GET REAL HOT!
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: A large armored soldier forcibly drags a young girl away from a chaotic battle while Drax fights enemies in the background, as narrator captions reflect on the hard lessons of leadership and the fall of Xandar.

dialogue.text: "YOU CAN'T LEAD FROM THE REAR." A HARD LESSON, HARD-TAUGHT BY A HARD TEACHER.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: DRAX.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: LET GO OF ME! I WANT TO STAY WITH DRAX!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: AND CAMMI. DRAX AND CAMMI. MUSTN'T FORGET THE GIRL. AS IF ANYONE COULD.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THOSE FIRST DAYS AFTER THE FALL OF XANDAR WERE UNBEARABLE. DRAX DIDN'T MAKE THEM ANY BETTER.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Drax lunges aggressively at Nova amid a chaotic battlefield while a narrator caption reflects on Drax earning his 'Destroyer' title, and a massive ground battle rages below.

dialogue.text: HEY! KREE BOY! WATCH THE HANDS!
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: GUESS THAT'S WHY THEY CALL HIM "THE DESTROYER." HE DESTROYED RICHARD RIDER, THE BOY, TO MAKE ROOM FOR NOVA, THE MAN.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A figure leaps through an explosion of debris while armored enemies with glowing red eyes emerge from green energy clouds on the right.
Drax charges forward in a green-hazed environment, firing energy blasts as he fights off a swarm of insectoid Annihilation Wave creatures surrounding him.
A armored figure is overwhelmed and swarmed by multiple fanged alien creatures in the darkness.
A massive energy beam strikes down amid a chaotic battle, sending combatants flying as Nova and others clash against alien creatures in a ruined environment.
A close-up of large menacing claws or talons, with a glowing orange eye visible in the background darkness.
Drax stands over Nova who is crouched amid energy flares and surrounded by enemies, trading terse remarks about taking down force fields.

dialogue.text: TOOK YOU LONG ENOUGH.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: YOU'RE WELCOME.
dialogue.speaker: drax

dialogue.text: ALL THE FORCE FIELDS ARE DOWN.
dialogue.speaker: drax

dialogue.text: TELL ME SOMETHING I DON'T KNOW.
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: Nova and Drax fly upward together through a beam of light while allies are dying around them covering the retreat.

dialogue.text: ANY OF OURS STOP TO COVER THE RETREAT, THEY GET AN UGLY DEATH. TOO MANY ARE STOPPING.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: OPTIONS?
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: Drax confronts Nova mid-battle, shouting a brutal moral choice about sacrificing hundreds to save thousands as a massive energy wave closes in on wounded soldiers.

dialogue.text: YOU KNOW DAS'T WELL WHAT YOU'VE GOT TO DO! THE WAVE IS CATCHING UP TO THE WOUNDED! LOSE HUNDREDS OR LOSE THOUSANDS. YOUR CHOICE.
dialogue.speaker: drax

dialogue.text: NO ONE LAYS A HARD TRUTH ON YOU LIKE DRAX.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: LOSE HUNDREDS OR LOSE THOUSANDS.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Nova blasts someone to the ground with twin energy beams from above while hovering in the night sky, leaving them dazed in a cloud of dust.

dialogue.text: POINT TAKEN.
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: Nova shouts tactical orders into communications during a chaotic battle, coordinating a blanket bombardment command.

dialogue.text: NOT ALL OF OUR PEOPLE WILL GET CLEAR, BUT IT'S GOT TO BE DONE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: COMMAND ALPHA PRIME TO BARRAGE COMMAND, DO YOU READ?
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: BARRAGE COMMAND TO ALPHA PRIME, WE READ.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: INITIATE BLANKET-BOMBARDMENT. COMMAND PROTOCOL: ONE ONE ALPHA/RIDER.
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: Nova, in close-up profile, issues a full-scope heavy ordnance barrage order over comms, then is questioned by a subordinate.

dialogue.text: ONE ONE ALPHA / RIDER CONFIRMED. RANGE AND DURATION?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: FULL-SCOPE HEAVY ORDNANCE BARRAGE. HOME IN ON MY POSTION AND CLEAR THE ZONE.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: SIR!?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A silhouetted figure floats high above a battlefield where armored soldiers fight amid flames, one soldier looking up toward the hovering figure.

dialogue.text: YOU HEARD ME.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: GOD SAVE MY SOUL...
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Nova internally monologues about relying on Drax to find him while insectoid alien creatures swarm through a fiery, explosive battleground near a moonlit alien structure.

dialogue.text: IF I'M LUCKY, DRAX WILL COME LOOKING FOR ME.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: IF I'M REALLY LUCKY, HE'LL FIND ME ALIVE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THEN ALL I HAVE TO DO IS CONVINCE DRAX NOT TO FINISH ME OFF FOR CHUCKING HIM AWAY DURING A BATTLE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: GOTTA LOVE HIM.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A massive space battle rages at the orbit perimeter of Dardalus Prime, with a large spacecraft exploding amid a swarm of smaller ships and energy blasts.

dialogue.text: THE REST I PICKED UP AFTER IT WAS ALL OVER AND DONE. PETER BRIEFED ME WHILE THE MEDICOS GREW ME A NEW RIGHT LEG.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Firelord attacks a flagship with his cosmic fire staff while surrounded by enemy forces, expending himself in the process.

dialogue.text: WHILE WE WERE RUNNING FOR OUR LIVES AND TRYING TO SHORE UP THE SECONDARY PERIMETER, FIRELORD ATTACKED THE FLAGSHIP.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: USED HIMSELF UP IN THE PROCESS. EXPENDED TOO MUCH POWER AND MADE HIMSELF VULNERABLE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A massive explosion tears through Annihilus's hive-mind command structure as a fiery figure (Firelord) battles insectoid Annihilation Wave creatures below, confirming suspicions about the queens being at the center of their command network.

dialogue.text: WE'VE LONG SUSPECTED THAT ANNIHILUS' QUEENS WERE DEAD-CENTER OF A HIVE-MIND COMMAND STRUCTURE. FIRELORD PROVED US RIGHT.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: QUEEN...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: A fiery humanoid figure stands on a dusty battlefield holding a flaming weapon, calling out to a 'queen' while massive mechanical alien creatures loom around them amid explosions.

dialogue.text: QUEEN...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Exterpia introduces herself to the Firelord as the most favored of Annihilus and demands he stand down his forces.

dialogue.text: I JUST WISH I COULD HAVE BEEN THERE TO SEE IT GO DOWN...
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: AH...THE FIRELORD. I AM EXTIRPIA, MOST FAVORED OF THE LORD ANNIHILUS. ORDER YOUR FORCES TO STAND DOWN.
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

scene: Exterpia confronts a massive armored figure (likely Galactus) declaring victory, but the opponent calmly questions the claim.

dialogue.text: YOU ARE DEFEATED.
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

dialogue.text: AM I?
dialogue.speaker: Galactus

scene: A fiery, muscular unknown figure raises a blazing weapon triumphantly while standing over a massive armored form, as a creature on the left delivers a cold taunt about imminent death.

dialogue.text: AND WHAT OF YOU? YOU REEK OF IMMINENT DEATH! YOU WILL SOON EXPIRE.
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

scene: Firelord unleashes a powerful energy blast, declaring 'ladies first' as the narrator explains he ended the battle by cutting off Extirpia from the wave.

dialogue.text: "LADIES" FIRST.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: FIRELORD ENDED THE BATTLE.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: ONCE EXTIRPIA WAS CUT OFF FROM THE WAVE, THEIR ATTACK FELL INTO DISARRAY.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Annihilus's massive insectoid flagship looms in space near a planet in the Kree system, surrounded by a fleet of smaller ships and debris.

dialogue.text:
ANNIHILUS FLAGSHIP.
KHIANDA 9.
KREE SYSTEM.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Annihilus rages about Extirpia's death while Thanos, displayed on a holographic screen, calmly corrects him that the orders were to apprehend, not terminate.

dialogue.text: INTOLERABLE! EXTIRPIA FALLEN AT THE HANDS OF HERALDS I HAVE ORDERED TERMINATED!
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

dialogue.text: YOUR ORDERS ARE TO APPREHEND, NOT TERMINATE, ANNIHILUS. THE FORMER IS THE MORE DIFFICULT.
dialogue.speaker: Thanos

dialogue.text: A LITANY OF EXCUSES!
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

scene: Thanos, accompanied by a small winged figure, addresses an armored figure (likely a Kree or similar) about acquiring resources and speaking coldly about Nova's distraction.

dialogue.text: YOU...REQUESTED THAT I DISCOVER THE BIOLOGICAL APPLICATION OF COSMIC POWER.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: I AGREED TO BE OF SERVICE. YOU AGREED TO ABIDE BY MY METHODS. THE RESOURCES I NEED ARE NOW AT MY DISPOSAL.
dialogue.speaker: Thanos

dialogue.text: WE'VE JUST SEEN THE POWER OF DISTRACTION--NOVA'S UNITED FRONT HAS NO IDEA WHAT WE HAVE ACQUIRED.
dialogue.speaker: Thanos

scene: Thanos smirks dismissively as a winged figure flies behind him, while dialogue exchanges suggest he is sending someone off on a task.

dialogue.text: HOW DISTRACTED WOULD YOU HAVE ME?
dialogue.speaker: Thanos

dialogue.text: INTOLERABLE! BE ABOUT IT THEN! GO! GO!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: AS YOU WISH.
dialogue.speaker: Thanos

scene: Annihilus furiously questions Ravenous about why the heralds continue to vex him, while Drax (serving under Annihilus) calmly explains that the heralds fight harder knowing they won't be killed.

dialogue.text: HOW IS IT THESE HERALDS STILL VEX ME?! WHY IS MY WILL THWARTED, RAVENOUS!?
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

dialogue.text: DUE RESPECT, BUT THEY KNOW THE LORD ANNIHILUS WANTS THEM ALIVE. REMOVE THE FEAR OF DEATH AND STRENGTHEN THE FOE.
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: Annihilus, looming large and enraged, denounces an unseen speaker while referencing the death of Extirpia and demanding vengeance fall on Extermina and Sister Eradica.

dialogue.text: LISTEN TO ITS PRATTLE! BELOVED EXTIRPIA IS TAKEN FROM US AND DOES IT CARE PAST ITS OWN SELF-INTEREST!?
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

dialogue.text: EXTIRPIA'S BLOOD--
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: VENGEANCE IS OURS BY RIGHT OF LINEAGE! LET THE BLOOD-DEBT FALL ON EXTERMINA AND SISTER ERADICA!
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

scene: Annihilus dominates the panel with a threatening close-up, warning an unseen subordinate in silhouette to be silent or face removal from command.

dialogue.text: SILENCE! MUST I RELIEVE THE TWO OF YOU OF YOUR COMMANDS!?
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

scene: Annihilus coldly informs Drax that Thanos has obtained what he needs, dismissing any further concern.

dialogue.text: THE THANOS CREATURE HAS THE SOURCE HE REQUIRES. HIS NEEDS ARE MET.
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

scene: A commanding armored figure orders Ravenous to terminate the heralds while Annihilus listens nearby, as someone mentions the ex-heralds.

dialogue.text: THEN THESE OTHERS, THESE EX-HERALDS...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: IRRELEVANT! THE PARADIGM HAS SHIFTED. DO WHAT-EVER IT TAKES, RAVENOUS. TERMINATE THE HERALDS!
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Drax snarls with intense fury, vowing vengeance against the heralds of Galactus.

dialogue.text: That which does not kill me makes me stronger. These are not the Silver Surfer.
dialogue.speaker: drax

dialogue.text: The last of Galactus' heralds will taste my vengance.
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: Annihilation Day Plus 206: Nova's verbal log narrates an uneasy alliance as Richard Rider sits on a bed beside a sleeping figure, while a holographic display glows nearby.

dialogue.text: VERBAL LOG. NOVA CORPS OPERATIVE: 11249-44396/ RICHARD RIDER. RESUMED.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: I'M NOT ALL THAT SURE HOW IT HAPPENED.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: GUESS IT'S TRUE THAT WAR MAKES FOR STRANGE BED-FELLOWS. NO PUN INTENDED.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: MNH?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: GO BACK TO SLEEP.
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: Nova (without helmet) and Gamora share a quiet, intimate moment in what appears to be a bedroom, exchanging banter as Nova looks at a photograph and prepares to leave to talk to Peter.

dialogue.text: HOWEVER IT HAPPENED, I'M GLAD IT DID.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THAT AN ORDER?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: A SUGGESTION. YOU'VE NEVER BEEN BIG ON ORDERS, GAMORA. IS SOMETHING WRONG?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: I'VE BEEN THINKING.
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

dialogue.text: UH-OH.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: YOU'VE BEEN HANGING AROUND WITH PETER TOO MUCH. YOU'RE DEVELOPING A SENSE OF HUMOR.
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

dialogue.text: BITE YOUR TONGUE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: I'VE GOT TO TALK TO PETER.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: SHOULD I BE JEALOUS?
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

dialogue.text: NO. I VALUE MY LIFE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: I JUST NEED TO TALK TO ONE OF MY OWN--A TERRAN.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: OH. WAKE ME WHEN IT GETS INTERESTING.
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

scene: Nova (without helmet) observes a group of injured or resting people in what appears to be a makeshift shelter or base, while a green-skinned figure sits slumped in a chair nearby and a bandaged figure rests to the right.

dialogue.text: SHE'S DEFINITELY SPENDING TOO MUCH TIME WITH PETER.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A solitary figure sits atop a ruined structure under a starlit sky, looking at something in their hand while shadowy figures linger in the background below.
A dark, abstract panel showing what appears to be a fractured or shattered surface in dim blue-grey tones, possibly debris or a cracked environment in space.
Two men without helmets talk in a corridor, one questioning why Gamora was left behind while the other curtly explains it was a matter of priorities.

dialogue.text: LET ME SEE IF I GOT THIS STRAIGHT. YOU FINALLY GET A FEW HOURS TO CALL YOUR OWN AND YOU LEAVE A LOOKER LIKE GAMORA TO HANG WITH ME?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: ONE WORD. PRIORITIES.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: SHE'S EXHAUSTED. WE ALL ARE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Two characters, one resembling Nova without helmet, discuss Gamora's and Peter Quill's reputations in a tense exchange.

dialogue.text: SHE WOULDN'T COME IN TILL THE LAST STRAGGLER WAS ACCOUNTED FOR.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: YOU ASK ME, GAMORA'S TRYING TOO HARD TO LIVE UP TO HER "MOST DANGEROUS WOMAN IN THE GALAXY" REP.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: YOU ASK ME, PETER QUILL SHOULD BE LIVING UP TO HIS "STARLORD" REP.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: NOBODY ASKED YOU.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Two unmasked soldiers or heroes converse in a dimly lit corridor, one recounting a recent victory while holding a device, the other listening with a neutral expression.

dialogue.text: DEPRESS ME.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text:
SIGH...WE WHUPPED 'EM GOOD THIS TIME AROUND. ONCE THEY STARTED RUNNING AROUND LIKE CHICKENS WITH THEIR HEADS CUT OFF, IT WAS OPEN SEASON.

PART OF ME STILL THINKS WE SHOULD HAVE PRESSED IT, DRIVEN THEM BACK.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Two characters in close-up conversation, one with a cybernetic eye implant questioning why the other didn't act when he had the chance, discussing the Firelord situation.

dialogue.text: WHY DIDN'T YOU? YOU HAD THE REINS.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: LAST TIME I PUSHED MY LUCK IT WENT BADLY.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: WHAT ABOUT THE FIRELORD?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: WHO CAN TELL?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Two unmasked characters converse about someone being brought in near-dead by Red Shift and the Kangaroo Guy, with the other heralds offering no useful information.

dialogue.text: RED SHIFT AND THE KANGAROO GUY BROUGHT HIM IN LOOKING ABOUT AS DEAD AS I'VE EVER SEEN.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: WHAT DO THE OTHER HERALDS HAVE TO SAY?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: NOTHING PAST A SHRUG.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Two men in civilian clothes converse in a corridor, one asking about a new guest.

dialogue.text: AND WHAT OF OUR NEW GUEST?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Nova without his helmet sits casually on a ledge while another figure in a blue uniform stands nearby in what appears to be a corridor or ship interior.

dialogue.text: FIGURED YOU WERE BUILDING UP TO THAT.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Two men in a corridor discuss someone's psi abilities being blocked and Nova expresses a desire to check on Firelord as well.

dialogue.text: C'MON. THEY JUST GOT THE PSI-BAFFLES UP AND RUNNING SO SHE'S NOT GONNA BE GETTING INTO ANYONE'S HEAD UNLESS WE WANT HER TO.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: YOU WOULD.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: I WANT TO STOP IN ON FIRELORD, TOO.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Nova (helmeted) briefs Nova_nohelmet on the Shi'ar's wait-and-see strategy and warns about the Badoon, while a shadowed figure stands between them.

dialogue.text: OH, F.Y.I., THE SHI'AR ARE HOLDING TO A "WAIT AND SEE" STRATEGY, ALL THE WHILE DENYING THAT'S WHAT THEY'RE DOING. HIGH-TONE SCRAGS, THE LOT.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: THE BADOON?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: HUNKERED DOWN. TRUST ME, WE DO NOT WANT TO BE DEALING WITH THE BADOON ON TOP OF ALL THIS.
dialogue.speaker: nova

scene: Drax sharpens his blades while complaining, surrounded by other figures in what appears to be a cramped holding area or barracks.

dialogue.text: ANYTHING ELSE?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: MY HEMORRHOIDS ARE ACTING UP. STILL BUCKING FOR THAT COURT-MARTIAL...
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: Drax cleans his blade while a seated figure teases him about resting instead of fighting, as they appear to be aboard a vessel with space visible through a window.

dialogue.text: "WE" HAVE HAD OUR FILL OF BATTLE TODAY.
dialogue.speaker: drax

dialogue.text: SIGH...BO-RING. YOU'RE DRAX THE DESTROYER. SHOULDN'T WE BE OUT THERE DESTROYING STUFF?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Drax approaches two figures among debris while making a sarcastic remark, and a green-skinned character with a gun responds with a complaint about being passed off to the Kree.

dialogue.text: HMPH...SOME DESTROYER. CAMMI...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: I THINK THAT KREE GUY MIGHT HAVE MOLESTED ME. YOU SHOULD BE MORE CAREFUL WHO YOU PASS ME OFF TO.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Drax points a blade toward a group of figures in the distance while an unseen character makes a quip about Thanos, and another tersely shuts them down.

dialogue.text: NOTED.
dialogue.speaker: drax

dialogue.text: BET IF THAT THANOS GUY WAS HERE--
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: DON'T.
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: Gamora confronts someone, accusing them of fighting the war only to get at a specific individual, while figures in armor stand in the background.

dialogue.text: Huh...can't fool me. The only reason you're FIGHTING this war is to get at him.
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

scene: A close, atmospheric shot of Nova seen from the side, showing only the edge of his helmeted head against a muted grey background.
Drax stares intensely toward a shadowed figure standing at a distance.
A close-up, partial view of a figure's face and shoulder in shadow, with only the side of the face and a hint of a red eye visible against a grey background.
Drax, with a grudging smirk, addresses a shadowy silhouetted figure across from him.

dialogue.text: CLEVER GIRL...
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: In a crowded medical bay, a group of personnel discuss isolating a patient while a glowing containment unit with disturbing organic contents sits in the foreground.

dialogue.text: ...ISOLATE HIM UNTIL WE HAVE A BETTER IDEA WHAT WE'RE DEALING WITH HERE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: BETTER SAFE THAN SORRY?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: EXACTLY.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Nova (without helmet) and two other figures examine a wounded or dormant figure suspended in a glowing medical/stasis unit, discussing confusing vital readings.

dialogue.text: NONE OF THE MONITOR READINGS MAKE SENSE. TECHNICALLY HE'S BOTH DEAD AND ALIVE.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: IS THAT EVEN POSSIBLE?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: NO. I MEAN, NOT THAT WE KNOW OF.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Nova without his helmet listens as a robot or armored figure explains the incomprehensible nature of what Galactus did, while another person responds stoically.

dialogue.text: WHATEVER GALACTUS DID TO HIM...IT'S WAY BEYOND ANYTHING WE'D RECOGNIZE. IT'S LIKE TRYING TO DECIPHER THE WORKINGS OF A GOD.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: WE'RE DOING ALL WE CAN.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: NEVER THOUGHT ANY DIFFERENT.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Nova gives instructions to a subordinate in a corridor, asking to be informed of any change in someone's condition.

dialogue.text: ANY CHANGE IN HIS CONDITION, I WANT TO KNOW AS SOON AS IT HAPPENS.
dialogue.speaker: nova

dialogue.text: YES, SIR.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Nova (without helmet) and another figure exchange terse words about Firelord's usefulness as either a hero or martyr, while a group of other characters stand in the background.

dialogue.text: YOU WANTED TO SEE.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: WRONG. I HAD TO SEE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: ALIVE, FIRELORD'S A HERO. DEAD, HE'S A MARTYR. EITHER WAY HE'S USEFUL.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: HOW COLD IS THAT?
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A narrator reflects on growing detachment from decision-making while armored figures move through a restricted detention facility.

dialogue.text: IT'S GETTING EASIER AND EASIER TO THINK THAT WAY, TO REMOVE MYSELF FROM THE DECISION.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: THAT WORRIES ME. A LOT.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Two figures stand before a large mechanical security system that has just confirmed a DNA match for Richard Rider, with one figure questioning whether their 'guest' could be useful.

dialogue.text: YOU FIGURE OUR GUEST CAN BE OF USE?
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: YOU SAW WHAT HAPPENED WHEN FIRELORD TOOK HER DOWN.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: GUESS IT CAN'T HURT TO ASK.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: POSITIVE DNA MATCH: RIDER, RICHARD. LETHAL RESPONSE DISENGAGED.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: In a large mechanical chamber, a robed figure holds up a glowing holographic image while exchanging quips with a cloaked alien figure, as other silhouetted characters look on.

dialogue.text: SHOULD'A BROUGHT HER FLOWERS. WOMEN ARE SUCKERS FOR FLOWERS.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: I'LL TRY TO KEEP THAT IN MIND.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Exterpia confronts two figures (one appearing to be Nova without helmet) in a mechanical corridor, accusingly asking if they've come to gloat over her despair.

dialogue.text: COME TO GLOAT? COME TO FEAST ON LOVING EXTIRPIA'S DESPAIR?
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

scene: Nova and Drax stand side by side facing someone in shadow, with Nova claiming he didn't come to gloat while Drax admits he did.

dialogue.text: I DIDN'T COME TO GLOAT.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: I DID.
dialogue.speaker: drax

scene: Exterpia looms above Nova and another figure without his helmet, taunting them that the war is won, while the two exchange terse words below.

dialogue.text: MAKE PEACE WITH WHATEVER AFTERLIFE WILL HAVE YOU. THIS WAR IS WON!
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

dialogue.text: DIDN'T GET THAT MEMO. YOU GET THAT MEMO, RICHIE?
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: DON'T PROVOKE IT.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Two men face someone off-panel, one speaking tersely while the other looks on grimly.

dialogue.text: SAY YOUR PIECE. I'M LISTENING.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Annihilus speaks to silhouetted figures about Galactus and the Silver Surfer, noting their fear of these cosmic beings.

dialogue.text: THE DEVOURER OF WORLDS, CALLED GALACTUS, AND HIS WRETCHED HERALD, CALLED SILVER SURFER.
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

dialogue.text: YOU KNOW OF THEM...YES. YOU KNOW OF THEM AND FEAR THEM...
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

scene: Exterpia looms over a defeated Nova, taunting him that while their battle raged, he lost the war elsewhere.

dialogue.text: WHILE OUR BATTLE RAGED, ELSEWHERE, YOU LOST THE WAR...
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

scene: A silver, metallic humanoid figure streaks through the air amid explosions and destruction, with a narrator caption referencing Extirpia and the Firelord's assault.

dialogue.text: "BEFORE THE FIRELORD'S BASE ASSAULT ON EXTIRPIA, EXTIRPIA KNEW! KNEW AS HER SISTERS KNEW!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A large silver creature and a glowing golden armored figure face each other amid fire and rubble while a caption declares that Thanos struck an alliance for the glory of their lord.

dialogue.text: "It was THANOS WHO STRUCK AN ALLIANCE WITH THEM, FOR THE GREATER GLORY OF OUR LORD!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A massive golden gauntleted fist slams into the ground, crushing or pinning a small silver figure amid crackling energy and debris.

dialogue.text: "THANOS KNEW OF THE ANCIENT ONES...
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Two armored cosmic figures clash in a blinding energy burst, with a caption referencing Aegis.

dialogue.text: ...AEGIS, SHE OF ALL SORROWS...
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Galactus clashes in massive cosmic battle against a giant dark armored entity (Tenebrous) amid explosions, crumbling structures, and swarming fighters.

dialogue.text: ...AND TENEBROUS, OF THE DARKNESS!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Galactus battles amid cosmic destruction and debris in space, with a narrator caption explaining the origins of beings imprisoned by the Devourer since the universe's youth.

dialogue.text: "FROM THE KYLN MOONS, THEY CAME. IMPRISONED BY THE DEVOURER WHEN THIS UNIVERSE WAS YOUNG.
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Two massive cosmic beings—Galactus and a large armored figure—face each other amid an explosive energy field as a caption recounts Annihilus destroying the Kyln.

dialogue.text: "AND WHEN THE GLORY THAT IS THE LORD ANNIHILUS SUNDERED THE KYLN..."
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Galactus unleashes a massive energy blast while a caption describes the freeing and arrival of powerful cosmic entities, with a dark armored figure looming on the right.

dialogue.text: "...THEY WERE FREED! AND THEY HAVE COME...
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A massive golden armored figure (likely Galactus) smashes through rocky terrain with enormous destructive force, debris flying everywhere.

dialogue.text: "...TO WREAK VENGEANCE ON THEIR PERSECUTOR AND ANY WHO DARE STAND WITH HIM!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: A massive clawed hand dominates the foreground while a large rocky figure (Galactus) is seen crumbling in the background amid energy and debris.

dialogue.text: "Each of power equal to Galactus!"
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Galactus is struck by a massive impact or assault, reeling backward as debris and energy explode around him.

dialogue.text: "EXTIRPIA SAW! SAW IT IN HER MIND'S EYE BEFORE THE FIRELORD'S ASSAULT!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Galactus strides powerfully through a fiery, rubble-strewn battlefield while a large armored figure observes from the right, as Extirpia declares Annihilus's victory.

dialogue.text: "EXTIRPIA SAW THE LORD ANNIHILUS' VICTORY! HIS WILL BE DONE!
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

scene: Galactus roars and fires a massive energy beam in an explosive close-up confrontation with another cosmic entity on the left.

dialogue.text: "DON'T YOU SEE...
dialogue.speaker: Galactus

scene: Galactus lies defeated and on fire, his massive body crashing down amid flames and destruction.

dialogue.text: "...GALACTUS HAS FALLEN!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

scene: Extirpia witnesses the cosmic battle as Thanos stands over a defeated Silver Surfer while Annihilus's forces look on, with dialogue exchanged about the fate of Galactus and his herald.

dialogue.text: EXTIRPIA SAW IT ALL!
dialogue.speaker: narrator

dialogue.text: "AND WHAT NOW FOR FALLEN GALACTUS AND HIS HERALD, THE SILVER SURFER?
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

dialogue.text: "THAT...THAT IS NOT FOR SUCH AS EXTIRPIA TO KNOW.
dialogue.speaker: Thanos

dialogue.text: "EXTIRPIA WILL SATE HERSELF IN KNOWING THAT THERE ARE THOSE WHO SERVE HER BELOVED LORD WELL.
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

dialogue.text: "BE THEY MAD TITAN OR ELDER GOD, THEY KNOW ANNIHILUS AS MASTER!"
dialogue.speaker: Exterpia

scene: Nova (without helmet) and another character face Annihilus, who declares the war is over.

dialogue.text: THIS WAR IS ENDED!
dialogue.speaker: Annihilus

scene: Nova without his helmet gives a cold order to alien attendants at a control panel in what appears to be a ship or facility interior.

dialogue.text: KNOCK HER OUT.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Two versions of Nova (Richard Rider) walk solemnly in the foreground while a shadowy figure looms behind them, one of the Novas speaking reverently about someone's will and way.

dialogue.text: HIS IS THE WILL! HIS IS... THE WAY! HIS...IS...IS...
dialogue.speaker: unknown

scene: Three figures walk through a dimly lit corridor near a spacecraft, exchanging skeptical remarks about something or someone.

dialogue.text: YOU BUYING THAT?
dialogue.speaker: Gamora

dialogue.text: IT SHOULD BE EASY ENOUGH TO CONFIRM.
dialogue.speaker: unknown

dialogue.text: THAT THING'S CRAZY AS A CAT IN A BAG.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Nova without his helmet gives a quiet, resolute reply, a scar visible on his face.

dialogue.text: SO ARE WE.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: Two silhouetted figures stand apart against a teal gradient background as one reflects gravely on the news that Galactus has been defeated.

dialogue.text: FOR THE RECORD, I BELIEVED EVERY WORD.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: THEY TOOK DOWN GALACTUS.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

dialogue.text: GOD HELP US.
dialogue.speaker: Nova_nohelmet

scene: A stylized 3D-rendered cassette tape character with curly tape ribbon limbs plays an electric guitar next to an 'EMPIRE ZONE' logo featuring a skull-and-tentacles emblem.
